title: Delhi ACP who led protest outside police headquarters suspended

ai.summary: Delhi police officer Manasvi Vashishtha was suspended for allegedly threatening lawyers during a scuffle at Shahdara police station in October, leading to a protest by 150 police personnel demanding his reinstatement and action against lawyers.

facts.claim: Delhi police officer Manasvi Vashishtha was suspended for allegedly threatening lawyers during a scuffle at Shahdara police station in October
facts.quote: An assistant commissioner of police in Delhi was suspended on Tuesday allegedly for leading a protest against his and another officer’s transfer after an alleged face-off between police personnel and lawyers in October

facts.claim: 150 police personnel staged a protest outside Delhi Police headquarters
facts.quote: On Monday, about 150 police personnel staged a protest outside the Delhi Police headquarters against the transfers.

facts.claim: Vashishtha was transferred from sub-divisional police officer of Gandhi Nagar to special police unit for women and children
facts.quote: While Vashishtha was transferred from the post of sub-divisional police officer of Gandhi Nagar to the special police unit for women and children

ai.background_note: A protest by Delhi police personnel over alleged misconduct of two officers led to their transfer and a subsequent strike by lawyers demanding action against the officers.
